items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: They come in and he was a pal of mine, him and I like this, even today

ctx.x: So we was playing and the stage door let out from the stage in the alley. Got to come there, come to the stage door, to come to the stage so the first night, man, we ain't never run in no segregation, so the first night different people from New York -- New York actors and big stars, so they come over and so Duke went down and sit at the table with them because he's a star, so this cat, this Greek or whoever he was, he say listen Mr. Ellington, we don't allow the help to socialize with the guests, I say, 'Duke…

nothing, so the next night George Raft was big then, star, big party 16, ringside. They come in and he was a pal of mine, him and I like this, even today, he say, 'Sonny, when you get off come on down --'
